lean.plain: Bound the local congruence length using cohomology
lean.note: The weighted sum of the local lattice-index terms is bounded by the rank at lift level $j$ times two contributions. One comes from the scale and the lattice sizes, and the other is the sum of the Sha lengths weighted by $\log\ell$, assumed summable here.
